$comment: Every line the guide says in her or his own words (wayfinding; no claims about an inductee). Each entry is a whole line, synthesized as one clip per guide voice by assets-src/audio/build_guide_audio.py, so nothing is stitched mid-sentence. {n} = inductee name (app/src/landing/data/inductees.json), {pos} = that inductee's possessive pronoun (pronouns below). The name is said once per line; after that, the pronoun. Facts about an inductee are never here: they come from the narration script (assets-src/audio/narration/), tied to verified fact ids. tour.rooms.<room id> holds the lines for each recreated room (arrivals, intros and nudges per object); the study keeps the tour-level lists.

greeting: Welcome in. Scroll down to meet the first inductee.
